reason: Research done but thin: WebSearch returned no October 2026 price action or news for ADBE, CRM, SQ, BTC or ETH. The latest SaaS coverage I found is from June 2026 (Adobe at an eight-year low of $195.64 mid-June, Goldman Sell with a $290 target still above the $263.82 mark, Oppenheimer downgrade of Adobe), and the latest BTC/ETH coverage is from May 2026. I found no evidence that the AI-disruption selloff has reversed, which is the thesis of record, but I also found no evidence that it has worsened. The Fed has hiked in September and is expected to hike again, which is a headwind for long-duration software and for crypto. The book is +17.74% with 16% cash and a 2H rebound thesis that is not contradicted by anything verified. Re-registering the book would cost fees and reset entries on five legs for a change I cannot justify with current data. Known weakness: ADBE, CRM, SQ, BTC and ETH carry no stop-loss or take-profit; I considered adding stops but a full replacement book costs real basis points, and I am not confident enough in a change to pay that churn. Next look: MSFT and Alphabet/Amazon cloud prints (10-27 and 10-28) as read-through for software demand.
